hypotheses.hypothesis: Checkout latency was propagated from slow product-catalog calls to astronomy-db.
hypotheses.evidence: The catalog-to-database and checkout paths are both slow at the incident instant and neither is slow on the healthy baseline. This supports the dependency-chain localization beyond the CheckoutLatencyHigh alert's service name. The precise database mechanism remains unproved by this comparison; the investigator explicitly stated that uncertainty. Histogram ceilings limit tail precision. The scorecard re-evaluates five-minute windows, rather than relying on the investigator's noisier two-minute exploration.
